summary: Phases 1-7 complete, green, and committed: Operators.lean vendored orphaned (Phase 1); HasDia renamed to HasDiamond across Connectives.lean/Axioms.lean/ProofSystem.lean/Modal/Basic.lean/Modal/Semantics/Birelational.lean (Phase 2); all 12 rfl _def bridge lemmas pre-landed per-module in LTL, Temporal, Bimodal, Propositional, and Modal formula files (Phases 3-7). Phase 8 (the atomic-batch switch: import Operators, delete 5 duplicate classes, delete 12 colliding notation declarations) was attempted and built green for its declared 6-file scope, but a full lake build surfaced 64 errors across 17 files the plan's Scope Hypothesis never enumerated -- proof scripts elsewhere in the tree matching against the concrete-constructor notation forms the deleted notation used to resolve to. 13 of those 17 files sit in territory explicitly forbidden to this agent (Propositional/SequentCalculus, Propositional/Tableau, Propositional/Metalogic), held by concurrently-running sibling tasks 615-617 on the same shared working tree. The Phase 8 edit set was reverted (git checkout to the Phase 7 commit) to keep the shared tree green for siblings; the full diff is preserved as a patch and stash for reapplication. A separate, independent regression was also found and fixed: the Phase 5/4 Bimodal and Temporal bridge lemmas pushed CslibTests/GrindLint.lean's runaway-instantiation check over threshold for four auto-generated sizeOf_spec lemmas (Bimodal/Temporal Axiom.linear_since/linear_until) -- fixed with #grind_lint skip entries, verified via a full lake test pass, and committed.

blockers.description: Deleting the 12 colliding local notation declarations (the plan's declared, necessary step) breaks 64 proofs across 17 files outside the plan's declared 6-file scope: Modal/LogicalEquivalence.lean; Propositional/SequentCalculus/{LJ,LK,LM}/Soundness.lean and SequentCalculus/LK/CutElimination.lean; Propositional/Tableau/{Intuitionistic,Classical}/Soundness.lean; Modal/Metalogic/{Intuitionistic/CanonicalModel,Completeness,Minimal/MinExtension}.lean; Propositional/Semantics/Algebra/{Soundness,HilbertAlgCompleteness,BrouwerianCompletenessGeneric}.lean; Propositional/Metalogic/StrongCompleteness.lean; Modal/Tableau/LoopChecking.lean (heartbeat timeout); Temporal/Metalogic/Chronicle/TruthLemma.lean; Propositional/NaturalDeduction/Normalization/Termination.lean. 13 of the 17 are in territory explicitly forbidden to this agent this cycle. Resolution in progress: team-lead has serialized this task behind tasks 614 and 618 (landing in the forbidden Propositional subtrees); once those complete, this task is re-dispatched solo with whole-tree write access to finish Phase 8 and fix all 17 files, reapplying the preserved patch as the starting point.

decisions_made: Territory conflict on Cslib/Foundations/Logic/ProofSystem.lean (a required Phase 2 call site) was reported as a blocker per protocol rather than edited across the declared line; team-lead investigated and granted it (unmodified on disk, no other task's plan claims it) before Phase 2 proceeded.

When Phase 8's full-tree build surfaced 64 errors in 17 undeclared files, the edit set was reverted rather than left uncommitted mid-fix, because the working tree is shared (not per-agent worktrees) with three actively-committing sibling agents whose lake build would otherwise also go red.

The revert used git checkout on exactly the 7 Phase-8-touched files (not a blanket reset), preserving unrelated concurrent dirty state (sibling task files, specs/TODO.md, state.json, events.jsonl) untouched.

The full Phase 8 attempt was preserved via bash .claude/scripts/git-snapshot.sh 619 --no-revert (a patch file, a stash, and an untracked-files backup) rather than discarded, so the follow-up dispatch does not have to re-derive the edit from scratch.

The GrindLint regression (four sizeOf_spec lemmas crossing the min:=20 runaway-instantiation threshold) was fixed with #grind_lint skip entries, matching the file's existing precedent category for auto-generated deriving-boilerplate lemmas, rather than attempting a grind_pattern side-condition -- the flagged lemmas are pure sizeOf boilerplate on the two most deeply-nested Axiom constructors, not user-authored logic that ought to stay grind-clean.

isIntuitionisticIff in Propositional/Defs.lean needed a hand-written proof (constructor / rintro / simp only [Proposition.imp_def]) rather than grind alone, even with the relevant bridge lemma supplied explicitly -- recorded as the demonstrated fix pattern for the 17-file cleanup still to come.
dead_ends: grind [Proposition.imp_def] alone does not close isIntuitionisticIff even though the bridge lemma is exactly the missing link -- grind did not chain the rewrite through the Set.range/existential-witness step automatically. A hand-written proof was required instead.
Set.range_subset_iff is not in this file's import closure (Unknown constant) -- do not reach for it without first checking Mathlib.Data.Set.Image is actually imported here.

A `/-- doc -/` block cannot precede a bare `#grind_lint skip` command in CslibTests/GrindLint.lean unless preceded by `#adaptation_note` (existing file convention); use a plain `--` line comment instead for new skip-entry documentation.

continuation_context.sequencing: Re-dispatch after tasks 614 and 618 land in Propositional/SequentCalculus/** and Propositional/Tableau/** respectively. Next dispatch should run solo with whole-tree write access to complete Phase 8 (reapply the preserved patch) and fix the 17 downstream files enumerated in the blockers entry and in the plan file's Phase 8 BLOCKER section.
continuation_context.zero_debt: No sorry, no new axiom, no vacuous definition introduced anywhere in Phases 1-7 or the GrindLint fix. Confirmed by build success (not weakened, not skipped).
